notablePrerequisites: Mirror Image does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Mirror Image using Civilized Scholar's ability by tapping it.
Resolve that ability and choose to modify it with dredge, causing you to mill at least one card, return the creature card with dredge from your graveyard to your hand, then discard that same card, untap Mirror Image and fail to transform it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Mirror Image
uses.cardState: as a copy of Civilized Scholar
